data.value: Preserve leaves video unchanged. Source frame rate outputs one progressive frame per frame. Source field rate preserves smoother field-rate motion with greater CPU and bitrate cost.

data.value: Copy preserves the original codec and quality. AC-3 or E-AC-3 re-encodes other audio for consumers that require that format.

data.name: Transcoding_GlobalBitrateHelp
data.value: Caps the H.264 encoder's target output rate. A cap that is too low can reduce quality during complex scenes even when CRF requests higher quality.

data.name: Transcoding_GlobalDeinterlaceHelp
data.value: Preserve leaves the source unchanged. Source frame rate creates one progressive frame per interlaced frame. Source field rate creates one progressive frame per field for smoother motion at greater CPU and bitrate cost.

data.name: Transcoding_GlobalPresetHelp
data.value: Controls H.264 encoding speed versus compression efficiency. Faster presets use less CPU; slower presets can achieve similar quality with less bitrate.

data.name: Transcoding_GlobalQualityHelp
data.value: Sets constant-quality H.264 encoding from 16 to 30. Lower values preserve more detail but use more bitrate; higher values reduce bitrate and quality.
